notes.title: Demo release!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

I want to announce that [b]the Demo version of the game is now available[/b]. You will be able to play the first level - Forest. Forgotten Fears is the second project that I am developing completely alone, so [b]any feedback will be appreciated[/b], it will allow me to fix any issues, rework something, or even add a new mechanic you would like to see in the level. Your feedback will allow me to understand my mistakes that I will try to avoid in the future.[b]

I hope you will have fun playing the Demo![/b]
